description: Daily history of one contract. With expiry alone it is the future for that expiry; with strike and option_type together it is that option, with iv and Greeks on days it traded. Required: symbol, expiry. to defaults to expiry, from to 6 months before to. Up to 250 rows per call, oldest first. End of day NSE equity derivatives from 2010-01-04, no BSE, no intraday. Tier: needs a Retail or Pro key (https://tejhq.dev/upgrade).

expiry.description: Expiry date of the contract. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

from.description: First date, inclusive. Default: 6 months before to. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Use meta.next_offset from a truncated result.

option_type.description: CE or PE, or CA or PA before 2011. Pass with strike.

symbol.description: Underlying symbol, for example NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE. Case does not matter.

to.description: Last date, inclusive. Default: the expiry. Format YYYY-MM-DD.

name: fo_contract
title: One F&O contract
